description:
You are reviewing a FastAPI-based inventory management API that your team has flagged as having critical security vulnerabilities. The project is already open in PyCharm at /home/ga/PycharmProjects/inventory_api.

The security team has reported that the application has multiple OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities that must be remediated before it can be deployed. No further details have been provided about which specific vulnerabilities exist or where they are.

Your job is to:
1. Audit the codebase and identify all security vulnerabilities
2. Fix every vulnerability you find
3. Ensure the test suite still passes after your fixes (run: python -m pytest tests/ -v)

The application serves a REST API for warehouse inventory. Login with admin/password123 is available in the README. You must NOT change the application's functional behavior — only fix security issues.

Hint: focus on authentication, input handling, data access controls, and secrets management.
